name: aws_cloudfront_distribution
description: Global CDN that delivers content with low latency and high transfer speeds via edge locations

enabled.name: enabled
enabled.description: Whether the distribution is enabled to accept end-user requests

aliases.name: aliases
aliases.description: Extra CNAMEs (alternate domain names) for the distribution (e.g., www.example.com)

default_root_object.name: default_root_object
default_root_object.description: Object to return when the root URL is requested (e.g., index.html)

is_ipv6_enabled.name: is_ipv6_enabled
is_ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support for the distribution

price_class.name: price_class
price_class.description: Price class for the distribution (controls which edge locations serve content)

web_acl_id.name: web_acl_id
web_acl_id.description: WAF Web ACL ARN to associate with the distribution

retain_on_delete.name: retain_on_delete
retain_on_delete.description: Disable the distribution instead of deleting it when running terraform destroy

wait_for_deployment.name: wait_for_deployment
wait_for_deployment.description: Wait for distribution to reach Deployed state after create/update

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the distribution
